title: Mixed Event — Let SEKAI Hear Your Song!

meta.Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGERS of each SEKAI see how everyone is progressing toward their goals. They are excitedly preparing ways to demonstrate their support for everyone, when something extraordinary happens.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
It's so nice to see you all again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And thank you for always watching over the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, it's been some time since you all started coming here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Quite a lot happened during that time, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They discovered their true feelings, which led to so many songs being born in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And now, they're trying to take their next big steps.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Isn't this so exciting?
I'm very much looking forward to seeing how they all grow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, look...!
Our other selves from SEKAI seem to be doing something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know! Why don't we go take a quick peek?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll see you all again next time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
Another day, another really fun practice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was fun!
I didn't think their improv show would end up being so good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I started tearing up towards the end!
I still can't believe they ad-libbed the whole thing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The story was very good, but they also had so much chemistry. Not to mention that their acting was very animated.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. They were all very into it. I can't help but feel inspired by them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That must be because they've grown and gone through so much together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They've become so much stronger since the first time they came to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They persevered in the face of hardship and never wavered. I suspect they were able to do that because they kept dreaming big.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. Making both their dreams as a group and their individual dreams come true seemed almost impossible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But after giving it an enormous amount of thought, weighing their options and working together, they found a way to stick together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll face more obstacles along the way, but my hope is that those won't stop them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I kinda want to do something for Tsukasa and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because they've been trying really, really hard!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And they made the decision to leave the Wonder Stage to set out into the world!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
In other words, you'd like to show them your support somehow.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly☆
I want them to know that we're here for them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's sounds wonderful! I'd love to help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One that'll really demonstrate our support for them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're going to demonstrate our support for Minori and the others by doing a show for them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exactly! I thought we could do one as a way to say that we're there for them since they're reaching toward new heights...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But how do we actually do that? Any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... What about a medley of songs that are really happy and full of energy?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I like where you're going with that!
But I think it needs to also feel a little special in some way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we perform the songs that they have during their past shows?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we could sing and perform dance routines that they themselves have done.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They've worked tirelessly to create wonderful things and spread hope to others. So, I thought we could show them what they've achieved.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's start getting everything together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After we've come up with a set list, we'll decide who's in charge of what and figure out what to do for each dance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
He really does!
I'm guessing his excitement level's only going to keep increasing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that means we should also feel just as motivated. This is for them after all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, let's do our best to put on a wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When Mafuyu went to tell her mom how she really felt that time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I heard that hearing Miku sing Kanade's song helped settle her down.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena also felt better after she heard me sing that time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I wanna learn how to be a better singer... For them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone in each SEKAI seems to be doing their best to show the others their support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what's going on in the other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't we go take a look?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, now that they've left... Shall we begin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Our surprise show's gonna be so amazing! I can't wait to see how they all react♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, slow down.
It's still not for a while.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you know they're gonna be totally blown away when they hear us playing their songs!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel...
However, our goal isn't just to surprise them. Our goal is to give them a boost of energy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. As their seniors, we need to do our best to motivate them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I am. I mean, we're doing this for Ichika and everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. That means you gotta be careful not to screw up, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know, so quit teasing me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You'll be singing for us, right?
Do you think you'll be ready?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so...
But I can't just sing like normal, you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (The way Miku sang that time with Ichika was so incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Which means...
If I'm going to be singing, I need to be able to push them forward like that too.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, lemme go get my stuff!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll start getting ready as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mmm! A lovely aroma as always.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, KAITO, I can't believe that you suggested that we do this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? I want to do something to support them too, you know.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I wouldn't expect you to suggest we put on an event with remixes of their songs!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I just thought that it would be the best way for us to show them our support.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I felt that it's the least we could do for them since they really need to stay strong right now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was so worried about them at first after they came up against such an enormous obstacle...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I also knew that they'd figure out a way...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because I know they have the power to overcome any walls or hurdles.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And they're already doing their best right now to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're trying to scale a very big wall, and there may be times when they feel like giving up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But I believe in them.
They'll fall and get back up as many times as they have to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That means we need to make our event one to remember!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'll help!
I really wanna try remixing some of their songs!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Rin, no fair!
I wanted to do that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that does sound like fun.
I'd like to do that as well♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, let's all do it together!
Just give me a second to finish drinking this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone in these SEKAI also seems to want to sing songs for them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Were you also seeing what everyone in each SEKAI was up to?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Does that mean you all were as well?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone in each SEKAI is planning and doing their best to sing songs and put on shows for the others...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure it'll mean a lot to them since they're all going through a crucial period right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I want to help our SEKAI selves succeed.
I want the others to really feel their support...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, Rin, you both looked really cute during that dance routine! Len, you exuded a princely aura! Lastly, MEIKO, Luka, I was blown away by your singing performance!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You all shined so much that I don't think we'll need to use any lights!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I appreciate the praise, but I feel a little embarrassed now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Minori and the others aren't gonna know what to do with themselves!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I doubt they will.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can't be satisfied with just this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, I think you can look even cuter and act yourself more during your solo when you're dancing on center stage.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, Len, you two could jump out in front and interact with the audience more. MEIKO, we need to synchronize our movements better.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Finally, KAITO, you should join us for this next one! It just doesn't feel the same if all six of us aren't involved.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes...
It would be nice to spread hope with all of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, give me a minute to get ready...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In the meantime, why don't we go through that dance routine again?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, let's really get it down!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I don't normally say things like what I just did...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(But I couldn't help myself...
I really want to show Minori and the others that we're there for them.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (We all feel the same way about that, don't we...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Of course we do. They're wonderful girls who always do their best for the sake of others...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (We all want them to keep advancing towards their goal.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means I need to keep doing my best to support them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
“I'm gonna try, master!
I'm gonna use this energy to make everyone smile...!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad Emu and the others are gonna get to keep pursuing their dreams together...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Don't ever let their smiles fade away...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice practice, everyone!!
You all did a wonderful job!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! Especially you, Miku!
You really gave it your all there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I started tearing up during the final scene☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're going a little overboard, Miku!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's quite impressive that you cry every time we practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All these emotions well up inside of me when I think about the others! I can't stop myself from crying!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I know I need to keep it together when we do this for real! Because I'm gonna cast a spell on all of them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I, uhh... I thought I heard someone's voice just now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel like we're being watched...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
By who?
Tsukasa and the others aren't supposed to be here yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Maybe it was just my imagination...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we do another run-through before they get here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
And let's get the lights all set up like we're doing this for real!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, good idea! Let's do that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think... They heard you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's amazing!
How'd you do that?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I-I'm not sure...
They were all doing their best, so I just...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I understand how you feel, Miku. I also wish I could show my support for everyone in each SEKAI sometimes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too...
If only there were a way for us to do that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Did something flash just now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. It looks like a ball of light.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Miku sounded way better than this during the girls' show.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (They launched everyone sky high just through their singing.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Which means I gotta figure out a way to sing like Miku did that time...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm playing my guitar just fine, but I'm not as happy with my singing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, Miku? What did you feel as you sang during the girls' show...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I was definitely having fun. It felt wonderful knowing that my singing was helping bring everybody together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not much other than that to be honest.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Also, well...
When I was singing, I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I tried to tell the girls that they can play even better. That they can keep going.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that sense, I sang with the hope to propel them forward.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The hope to propel them forward...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I realized something after spending so much time with them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We may not be able to do much for them directly, but we can think about things and try to come up with good solutions together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Singing is the same. You can't solve people's problems directly with it, but you can move them or show support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Which is why...
I wanted to sing in a way that would help Ichika and the others achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanted to help the girls move forward even just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I have a much better idea of what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're welcome, and good luck.
I'll be heading back to practice now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! See you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
There's something shining by that chair...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Did Rin drop it?
Saki did just get her some new accessories.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess I should pick it up for her and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Kanade's song really does have this warmth to it...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's like it knows how to meld with your heart and comfort you in just the right way...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (When Miku sang that time, she must've done so to try to convey Kanade's feelings and comfort Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna learn how to sing like that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mizuki and Ena bought some snacks for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A-And we were looking for Rin...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin wants to focus on what she's doing right now, so you shouldn't disturb her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Is something bothering her...?
Are you sure she doesn't need our help...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nothing's bothering her.
It's just... I'm sure she'll come see you when she feels she's ready.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We understand...
For now, let's go join the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll set aside some of these for Rin.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: S-So, um... MEIKO, you're welcome to join us. We'll be just over there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I can't do what Rin's doing right now...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, Luka! Quit trying to sneak in another nap!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, can I use your lap as a pillow...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'll let you over there, so try to stay on your feet until then!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Haha. They're so close!
Anyway, let's start putting away all the props!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I'm still wondering about that voice I heard earlier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, when you thought someone said, “You can do it.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But you guys didn't hear anything, right...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you also mentioned that you felt like we were being watched.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think I felt that too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It could be that our other selves from another SEKAI are trying to cheer us on.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Remember the story I told you about how I was sent to that strange SEKAI after touching a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
You saw us there! But it wasn't really us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We have no way of knowing what goes on in any of the other SEKAI. That being said, some of our various counterparts may be trying to show their support for us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But why would they be doing that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's an excellent question...
You would think that they'd be trying to help the owners of the feelings of their respective SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: The plushies were practicing for the show and fell into the fountain by accident!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?! That's terrible!
Sorry, I need to go help them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Us from different SEKAI...
I wonder what they're like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd love to meet them even just once☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That shiny thing. What is it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's so bright!
Maybe it's a prop we used for one of our shows...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The way it flashed... I didn't know what was happening and...! Was it part of the stage lighting? Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
These floaty things...
I'm seeing all sorts of different places!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm... What's this one showing?
There's a big tent, a flying train and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are all these all different SEKAI?! Are the other versions of us from these places?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What about this one...?
Hey, there's a bunch of big stages!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And this one's all white and empty...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is so much fun☆ I didn't know each SEKAI was so different!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what else there is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This could be another SEKAI born out of someone's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which means that thing had to be a fragment of a feeling! But what feelings was this SEKAI born from?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm not sure, but look...
I think I see each of the others' SEKAI among all these floating fragments.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right...!
Does this mean we can peer into a bunch of different SEKAI from this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Possibly.
For now, let's try to learn more about where we are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right.
It looks extremely expansive, so why don't we split up to cover more ground...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only is our SEKAI visible from inside a fragment, but I can see all these other ones as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I thought this might be another person's SEKAI at first... But I guess it's not.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, who would know this many SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I knew it!
Hi, me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This is so amazing!
I wasn't sure if this was actually possible!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been watching you this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! The way you express yourself through singing is so great! And you have such a beautiful voice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I'm really not that great a...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't say that! I know you're doing your best for everyone, so I'm gonna keep rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, since we're here together like this, let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet we'd sound amazing if we sang together right now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a strong source of support for the others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All we can do is watch over them, but I can see that they're in good hands!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I haven't really done anything for them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin and the others are the ones who help them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? I think you've done plenty for them already.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! Based on what I've seen watching you all this time, it's obvious to me that they need you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't always have to put what you feel into words. They feel better just knowing that you're there for them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure either. I just ended up in this SEKAI for some reason...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, that also happened to me.
Still... Hmm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, it's just... I look...
I mean, you look so cool!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm still not sure how I got here, but it's really great to meet you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I feel the same way. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This gives me an opportunity to thank you for doing what you can for the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your cheerful personality and the way you freely express yourself through words and music have been an enormous source of support for them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've been wanting to meet you for the longest time! You're such a great guitarist, you're mature and you're so cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! You were just having guitar practice, right? It's super cool how you're trying to pull everyone forward through your singing and playing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know so! Which is why I also need to do better!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's so wonderful how you're able to spread so much hope as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you shine so brightly each time you take the stage. I get a huge boost of encouragement whenever I see you perform...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm a source of encouragement for you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll put your words to good use by shining even brighter moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Are you me?! Is this really happening?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've been watching what you've been doing for so long!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The shows you put on are always so fun and exciting. It's wonderful how they put smiles on everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have! They always fill me with so much hope and joy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is also why I know that you've been doing your best to support the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if they get stuck or run into a problem that they don't know how to solve in the future...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm sure they'll be fine!
Because I know you'll be there to help them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, keep up the good work!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now, can you tell me more about yourself?! I wanna learn more about this me I don't know☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh...
I think this SEKAI is about to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! But I wanna keep chatting...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too. After finally getting a chance to meet you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, before we have to go!
There's something I need to ask you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When I was practicing for my next show just now, I heard someone say, “You can do it!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was cheering you all on so that you can keep doing your best for the others!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh?
I'm back in my own SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But I wanted to talk to her more...
Does this mean I'm never gonna see her again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You won't believe it!
That voice I heard before was Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, the one that said, “You can do it!”
It was me, but not me, and she was trying to cheer for me and for all of us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
H-Hang on...
Take a deep breath for me first. Then, say what you just said a little more slowly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Interesting...
And you met a different Miku in this strange SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup!
Me-but-not-me said our shows give her lots of encouragement every time she watches!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She also said how Tsukasa and the others are gonna be just fine as long as we keep trying our best for them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And she wished us luck in the end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, we'll also need to do our best to not disappoint her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Our show's gonna be so amazing☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I still can't believe what happened.
To think that I'd meet another me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I thought we were the only ones watching over Vivid BAD SQUAD from a SEKAI until now.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But to find out that there are others watching over us...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can't help but feel encouraged!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? KAITO, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Len and the others have been looking all over for you. They're mad about you not helping them get ready for our event!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, Luka, you met a different Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and guess what she said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She thanked us for always supporting the girls and said she hopes that we'll keep doing our best since all they can do is watch over them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That means this other you also wants what's best for Minori and the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She does. She may even be watching over us and this SEKAI right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, we have to make our show the best we've ever done! To give hope not just to Minori and the others, but to this other Luka as well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree!
Which means we'll have to practice quite a lot to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
He is...
Something good must've happened.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Like what?!
Oh, maybe he won some free ice cream or something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Only you and KAITO would be jumping for joy over that, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I think our show's going to be quite a good one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can tell from the way you're singing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You want them to feel your kindness. You want to be there for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, for Mafuyu's sake. For all their sakes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, I'm singing on behalf of the other me watching over me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Miku and MEIKO sound amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never heard anyone sing like this...! It's like I'm learning about a completely new style!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and KAITO did a good job with these remixes. They give off such a different impression compared to what we originally had.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You can tell that he worked on them. They have this fun side to them. It kinda makes me want to start singing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woooooow!
You all look way too cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, look! Miku's doing my part of the dance!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Len and KAITO are also spectacular.
They both look very cool and bring such a powerful presence to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I had a feeling they were doing something in secret. I guess this is what they were preparing for.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You know, I almost forgot how much people shine up there...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because we never get many chances to watch these kinds of shows as members of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I mean, I know that Miku and the others aren't singing our songs and dancing our dances exactly like we did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I guess this is what our fans see when they watch us perform.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is what we've been doing.
We've been spreading hope to all sorts of people!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think that's what Miku and the others are trying to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright!
That means we gotta keep doing more and more and more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
I can't believe they're really playing our songs...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it's so thoughtful of them...
At the same time, it's a little strange to be hearing someone else play them...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I'm not sure anyone else has played our songs before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku put on an unbelievable performance during our last show, but Len's just about on par with her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I need to keep moving forward...
I think that's the message they're trying to send.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is nice. It's really soothing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Kanade's song was already really good, but this feels so...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess this is what she's been focusing on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never would've thought she was practicing her singing. That's actually pretty cute of her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah!
On top of that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To think that we'd also get to hear her sing like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, it's pretty rare of her to want to sing for others like this.

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Magic is not what creates joy.
Joy is what creates magic.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “That is why you, Shao, were able to become such a wonderful sorcerer. It's because you were immersed in smiles, laughter and joy for so long.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “No, not just you. Everyone here. They're all sorcerers in their own right...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“The lights went out...
The horses and the flying rides...
They've all just stopped...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“No, I don't want this to happen...!
Master worked so hard to build this place for everybody here...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“Wait, no...
This is no time to be crying...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “This was the last thing Master told me! Everybody here can use magic because you're all smiling, laughing and making this such a happy place...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “I can't do this alone! I'm not as good at using magic like Master was, so please, lend me your energy...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Lend me your smiles, your joy, your magic...!!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
We'll give you everything we can!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hey, you're shouting right in my ear...

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“I'm gonna try, master!
I'm gonna use this energy to make everyone smile...!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...! Look, you guys...!
Everything's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She just lit up all of SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This must've taken a monumental amount of time to get set up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it was definitely worth the effort...
I'm staggered.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed it is! What a wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The others are probably gonna have to solve a lot of really tough problems in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And they might have a really, really hard time overcoming some of them...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wanna keep doing everything I can for them.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I probably wouldn't know what to do if I were all by myself, but with KAITO, Len, Rin, MEIKO, Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The other Miku that's watching over us. We'll figure out a way! Together!)
